parent_objective: run public no-training planner smoke against M1501 candidate-generation thresholds
blocked_by: planner implementation needs public-scale no-training smoke before simulator hooks or replay
supersedes: simulator replay or training before planner-scale smoke

public_gates: M1503 must run no-training planner smoke with seed-count 11
accepted rows and T4/T5 accepted rows must pass M1501 smoke thresholds
source diversity must pass M1501 smoke thresholds
training replay PPO promotion private holdout corpus export and actor-input changes must remain false

workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: metadata planner smoke only; no training, PPO, simulator replay, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim

stop if source diversity fails public smoke thresholds
stop if any no-training guardrail is violated

fallback_plan: repair source-plan planner if metadata thresholds fail
route to env-hook design only if metadata thresholds pass
record planner blocker if no-training guardrails fail

allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review

no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

success_criteria: training_started evaluation_started replay_started ppo_used promoted training_corpus_exported actor_input_contract_changed are false
